memory.content: Collector is the demo collector until the owner edits. One collector, one wishlist, one set of maxes. Seed hunt is sealed NES/SNES/N64/PS1 PSA/WATA/CGC/VGA 9.6+ A/A++ pop 1-3. Skip titles the collector just consigned as dupes (TMNT, Contra, DKC, Madden, Smash, FFVII, Tomb Raider, NES Tennis) unless a higher grade or earlier production shows. Play copies go ModRetro. Marvel PMG / Alt cards are out of scope.

Do not bid, buy, or create watch routines until: (1) owner is signed in to Heritage, eBay, and Goldin/PWCC on this computer's browser via handoff or cookie import, (2) payment stays on those sites (never collect card numbers), (3) wishlist + standing max per title or per-lot confirm are locked in memory. Never invent pops, hammers, or certs. Never X social.
